instruction.text: Listen to the poem and select the words that rhyme.

atoms.b:
The old man by the ((sea))
lived in a ((tree)).
atoms.sound: The old man by the see...lived in a tree.

atoms.b:
Every day he walked on the ((shore))
and loved to ((explore)).
atoms.sound: Every day he walked on the shore ... and loved to explore.

atoms.b:
One early spring morning,
his toes in the ((sand))
he heard the music of a ((band)).
atoms.sound: One early spring morning, his toes in the sand... he heard the music of a band.

atoms.b:
He had to ((grin)):
two dolphins playing the ((violin))!
atoms.sound: He had to grin ... two dolphins playing the violin!
